memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Rheumatoid arthritis
- Status: New diagnosis, joint pain and swelling in MCP joints, morning stiffness 45 min, ESR elevated.
- Plan: Start methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD; weight 68 kg, waist 82 cm; diet advice: breakfast - low glycemic, lunch - balanced with vegetables, dinner - light protein.
Due: HbA1c - N/A

Rheumatoid arthritis
- Status: Persistent morning stiffness 30 min, mild joint tenderness, weight 67 kg, waist 80 cm (at cut-off).
- Plan: Continue current DMARDs, reduce prednisolone to 2.5 mg OD, add folic acid if missed, advise breakfast - high fibre, lunch - legumes, dinner - fish; repeat labs in 6 weeks.

Rheumatoid arthritis
- Status: Flare with increased pain in wrists, morning stiffness 50 min, weight 69 kg, waist 84 cm (>80).
- Plan: Increase methotrexate to 15 mg weekly, add short course prednisolone 10 mg OD for 5 days then taper, continue hydroxychloroquine, folic acid; diet advice: breakfast - protein rich, lunch - mixed veg, dinner - light carb.

Rheumatoid arthritis
- Status: Improved, morning stiffness 20 min, mild joint tenderness, weight 68 kg, waist 81 cm (slightly above cut-off).
- Plan: Taper prednisolone to 1.25 mg OD, continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine, folic acid; advise breakfast - oats, lunch - quinoa salad, dinner - steamed veggies; repeat labs in 3 months.
